chunks.t: Part 1: Before You Start – Getting set up
chunks.x: Getting set up | Open Options first: rebind controls and use the FPS slider if the game lags., The game writes periodic automatic backups, but they are not a substitute for saving often., This binder follows the wiki walkthrough's 12 sections. Area pages on the wiki carry the full maps; the PokéPod here lists wild Pokémon, items and trainers per area.

chunks.t: Part 2: Moki Town → Nowtoch City
chunks.x: Prices may be stale: 1.4.0c tweaked item prices, so wiki shop prices may be out of date. [patch notes] | Moki Town | Withdraw the free Potion from your bedroom PC, then talk to Auntie downstairs for the Running Shoes., The NPC outside the first house across the street gives a Rare Candy., Head north to the lab. Your rival Theo stops you outside; inside, Professor Bamb'o's Trainer Test picks your starter (Orchynx, Raptorch or Eletux) unless you choose directly., Theo battles you right away. Losing does not end the game., Visit Theo's house (east side, by the breakable rocks) — his dad Cameron gives you the PokéPod: map, music player and phone for rematches., Meet Bamb'o by the west exit for the catching tutorial, the Pokédex and 5 Poké Balls. He hands out Pokédex rewards later. | Wild Pokémon [Starter Pokémon]: Orchynx (Grass Steel) Lv5 100%, Raptorch (Fire Ground) Lv5 100%, Eletux (Water Electric) Lv5 100%

chunks.t: Gym 1: Nowtoch City Gym (Maria) – Normal Badge, Normal
chunks.x: Maria is the first Tandor gym leader, in Nowtoch City. Rewards: Normal Badge · TM27 Return · prize ₽1200 Gym puzzle: No puzzle: get Maria's house key from the man at the door, use it on her house in the far south-east, then follow her back. Tips: Maria's team is all Normal-type; a Fighting-type such as Mankey (Route 2) hits everything for super-effective damage.
